svg.title: For the nonoscillatory low-frequency bound set t = hs, q = p/(hs). The denominator is dt(q) = P3 ν=0 q2 ν sinc(tqν/2)2. For ∥q∥≤1, 0 ≤t ≤2, the sinc bound 2/π gives dt(q) ≥(2/π)2∥q∥2. Each normalized difference numerator is at most |qν| ≤1, so the normalized cutoffsymbol is bounded by (π/2)2∥q∥−2 regardless of list length. For centered integer momentum lifts in the cube Bm, |Bm| ≤(2m + 1)4. On Bm \ B⌊m/2⌋inverse squared norm is at most 4/m2. Strong induction gives P p∈Bm ∥lift(p)∥−2 ≤432m2, with zero term assigned zero: the inner bound is 108m2 and outer bound (3m)4(4/m2) = 324m2, starting at m = 0. Writing η = 2π/N, T = η/t, rescaling bounds the unit-ball inverse-square sum by 432T −4. Multiply by physical normalization (Nh)−4s|D|−2 and use Ts = 2π/(Nh):
